name: S-Kyuu Ren'ai
source:
Tucked away in a dingy corner of Shinjuku is an agency of fake mediums.
They use their winning smiles to swindle the easily-deceived out of a ridiculous amount of cash!
Due to certain circumstances, you find yourself working alongside these unprincipled men.

“Well, what’ll it be? Want to increase your chemistry with me?”
Throw all you know about love stories out the window.
This one will turn your life around!

“Can you NOT make me into some reverse harem heroine?” *cries*

[from [url=https://www-en.voltage.co.jp/2021/11/04/2741/]Voltage[/url]]
translation:
新宿一處昏暗不起眼的角落，藏著一家假靈媒事務所。
他們憑藉迷人的笑容，從容易上當的人手中騙取鉅額錢財！
因為某些緣由，你竟要與這群毫無原則的男人共事。

「那麼，怎麼樣？要不要和我增進一下默契？」
把你對戀愛故事的所有認識，都拋到腦後吧。
這段故事，將徹底顛覆你的人生！

「能不能別把我弄成逆後宮女主角啊？」（哭）

[摘自[url=https://www-en.voltage.co.jp/2021/11/04/2741/]Voltage[/url]]
